title: Apple's amazing AirPods are taking a baby step towards their full potential (AAPL)
text:
June 6, 2018 admin Trading Ideas Comments Off on Apple's amazing AirPods are taking a baby step towards their full potential (AAPL)
Apple will reportedly add Live Listen technology to its AirPods later this year. The addition of Live Listen to the AirPods was first reported by TechCrunch earlier on Tuesday. The AirPods, which have been hailed as one of Apple’s greatest inventions in recent memory, will expand the reach of Live Listen, and let far more people take advantage of a potentially very handy feature. …read more
